function.name: get_url_content

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the most common tools and platforms you can use to book flights—whether you’re searching manually on a website, using a mobile app, or integrating flight data into your own application via an API.

| Category | Tool / Service | What it offers |
|----------|----------------|----------------|
| **Web & Mobile Booking Sites** | **Google Flights** | Fast, intuitive search with price‑tracking and flexible date grids. |
| | **Skyscanner** | Global price comparison, “Everywhere” search, and price alerts. |
| | **Kayak** | Aggregates fares from many sources, includes hotel & car options. |
| | **Expedia** | Bundles flights with hotels, car rentals, and vacation packages. |
| | **Orbitz / Travelocity** | Similar to Expedia, often with loyalty points. |
| | **Momondo** | Known for uncovering hidden‑fee carriers and price‑comparison. |
| | **Hopper** | Uses predictive analytics to tell you when to book. |
| | **CheapOair** | Focuses on discounted fares and promo codes. |
| | **Priceline** | Offers “Name Your Own Price” and “Express Deals.” |
| | **Travelocity** | Good for package deals and customer support. |
| | **Airbnb Experiences** | Not a flight booker, but useful for travel planning. |
| | **Airline Websites** (e.g., Delta, United, Lufthansa, Emirates) | Direct booking, loyalty miles, and sometimes exclusive fares. |
| | **Mobile Apps** (e.g., Hopper, Skyscanner, Google Flights, Kayak) | On‑the‑go booking, push notifications for price drops. |
| **API & SDK Platforms** | **Amadeus for Developers** | Comprehensive flight search, booking, and ancillary services. |
| | **Skyscanner API** | Search, price alerts, and flight availability. |
| | **Kiwi.com API** | Multi‑city itineraries, “Nomad” search, and booking. |
| | **Travelport Universal API** | Enterprise‑grade flight, hotel, and car booking. |
| | **Sabre API** | Global distribution system (GDS) for airlines, hotels, and more. |
| | **FlightAware API** | Real‑time flight status, not booking but useful for itinerary tracking. |
| | **OpenSky API** | Flight data for developers, not booking. |
| | **Google Flights API** (unofficial) | Limited access, mainly for research. |
| **Command‑Line / CLI Tools** | **skyscanner-cli** | Search flights from terminal (open‑source). |
| | **amadeus-cli** | Quick flight search via Amadeus API. |
| | **flight-scraper** | Scrape flight data from public sites (requires compliance). |
| **Travel Aggregator Bots** | **Chatbots** (e.g., Expedia’s chatbot, Kayak’s chatbot) | Voice or text interface for booking. |
| | **Voice Assistants** (Alexa, Google Assistant) | “Book a flight to Paris next Friday” commands. |
| **Specialty & Niche Platforms** | **Momondo** | Great for low‑cost carriers. |
| | **Airfarewatchdog** | Alerts for discounted fares. |
| | **Secret Flying** | Finds error fares and flash sales. |
| | **Scott’s Cheap Flights** | Email alerts for cheap flights. |
| | **Airfarewatchdog** | Alerts for discounted fares. |
| | **FlightRadar24** | Real‑time flight tracking, not booking. |
| | **TripIt** | Organizes itineraries, not booking. |
| | **Google Trips** | Organizes travel plans, not booking. |

### How to Choose

| Need | Recommended Tool |
|------|------------------|
| **Best price comparison** | Skyscanner, Google Flights, Kayak |
| **Bundle flights + hotels** | Expedia, Orbitz, Travelocity |
| **Frequent flyer miles** | Airline direct sites, Amadeus API |
| **Predictive pricing** | Hopper |
| **Developer integration** | Amadeus, Skyscanner, Kiwi.com, Sabre |
| **Low‑cost carriers** | Momondo, Secret Flying, Scott’s Cheap Flights |
| **Real‑time status** | FlightAware, FlightRadar24 |

Feel free to let me know if you’d like deeper details on any specific platform, or if you’re looking for a particular type of booking tool (e.g., for a travel agency, a mobile app, or a personal trip).
